Generate an Angular-style commit message from uncommitted changes

Usage:
  ycy git cm [flags]

Flags:
  -b, --body                           Allow a short commit body
  -d, --dry-run                        Generate and print only
  -h, --help                           help for cm
  -l, --lang string                    Commit message language: en or zh (default "en")
      --profile string                 CM provider profile to use
  -p, --push string[="origin"]         Push to remote after creating the commit, defaults to origin
  -s, --stage                          Select files to stage before generating
  -a, --stage-all                      Stage all changes before generating
  -c, --stage-push string[="origin"]   Select files to stage, commit, then push, defaults to origin
  -S, --staged                         Only use staged changes
      --timeout-ms string              Provider request timeout in milliseconds

Global Flags:
      --log-format string   Diagnostic format: text or json
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
      --quiet               Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose             Enable debug diagnostics
